public_rationale: Contemporary research documents arithmetic weaknesses, but the claim compares an LLM with a particular child. The searches did not locate independently inspectable results for that child or a matched comparison. General model failures cannot fill that gap, and the absence of a public test does not show the claim was false.
limitations: A private comparison may have occurred.
Unspecified model and testing conditions prevent reconstruction of the asserted comparison.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The first author's own nine-year-old child can do five-digit multiplication better than an LLM.

statement.excerpt: The first author’s nine-year-old can do five digit multiplication better than an LLM.
statement.document_title: Reports of the birth of AGI are greatly exaggerated

our_interpretation: This is a comparison involving the author's particular child, not an average nine-year-old.
Five-digit multiplication ordinarily means multiplying two five-digit integers.
Better is read primarily as a higher proportion of correct answers on comparable problems, with time and permitted aids disclosed.
The claim concerns the child's ability at the post date. It is not a conditional forecast.
An LLM is unspecified; a valid comparison must identify the contemporary model and its configuration.
criteria.support_condition: A documented comparison shows the named child answering comparable five-digit multiplication problems more accurately than an identified contemporary LLM under disclosed conditions.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented comparison under the claimed conditions shows the identified LLM matching or exceeding the child's accuracy.

evidence.excerpt: Yet, these models simultaneously show failures on surprisingly trivial problems.
evidence.explanation: The paper investigates multi-digit multiplication among several reasoning tasks. Such model-side evidence cannot establish a comparison with an untested individual child.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Dated, inspectable records of the child's and the identified contemporary model's answers to comparable five-digit multiplication problems, with scoring and permitted aids disclosed.
